what: Brazilian cooperative bank moved ECC to S/4HANA on RISE via Bluefield in 15 months (Jul 2024–Sep 2025), final cutover inside a 36-hour downtime window.
First US federal department fully on SAP S/4HANA, covering 14,000 users across ten bureaus; SAP reports gains in efficiency, analytics and cybersecurity.
Consolidated three legacy ERPs (Oracle, SAP ECC) into one S/4HANA private cloud on Azure; about 2,500 domestic users in 14 countries went live July 2023.
Australia's first Bluefield S/4HANA move (ECC EHP7 to 1709, new GL, cloud, Unicode in one step) took under 6 months with under 36 hours business downtime.

company: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
what: Bluefield conversion of a multi-domain SAP environment went live January 2024 with near-zero downtime using automated migration tooling; no figures published.
First Italian municipality on S/4HANA for finance and accounting; go-live slipped a year to 1 January 2025, with 1,400 users on the system from 18 January.
Switzerland's largest S/4HANA transformation: first division live June 2023, two more divisions January 2025; later divisions still to come. No cost or downtime published.
Consolidating 83 central SAP applications toward 40 by 2030; the One-Finance instance move to S/4HANA was about three months into a 12-month plan.
HMRC cluster moving from SAP ECC to S/4HANA under UK shared services: £246m SAP deal, rated red in 2023 then amber; HR/payroll deployments not yet live.
